newsitem.title: CANADA: Anvil to place shares with Cominco.
newsitem.headline: Anvil to place shares with Cominco.

text.p: Anvil Range Mining Corp said on Wednesday it arranged for a private placement to Cominco Ltd of 4.1 million common shares from treasury at C$2.30 a share for a total of C$9.4 million.
The deal is subject to Cominco's completing due diligence by January 31. Anvil Ranges owns and operates the Faro lead-zinc mine in the Yukon where mining operations were suspended on December 20.
"Additional financing will be required to restart operations and Anvil Range is actively pursuing such additional financing," the company said.
Cominco is Anvil Range's marketing agent in Europe and is making this investment to provide long-term support to Anvil Range's European concentrate customers.
